visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a floral sleeveless top and blue jeans, stands excitedly in front of a FamilyMart convenience store entrance, gesturing with her hands together. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up shot of a soft-serve ice cream machine dispensing a two-toned brown and beige swirl into a purple paper cup. (3) The main woman is now outside against a blue corrugated metal wall, holding a small microphone and interviewing two young women in casual clothing. One woman wears a blue T-shirt with a palm tree logo. They are smiling and laughing. (4) The woman is now back in front of the store, interviewing a different woman wearing glasses and black overalls over a white T-shirt. (5) A series of quick cuts show various women tasting the ice cream from cups using plastic spoons inside the store. The background shows shelves of merchandise and bright indoor lighting. (6) Close-up shots of the ice cream in a pink and purple cup, showing textures of the soft serve. (7) The main creator holds a purple cup with a straw and a soft-serve cone, pointing to promotional text overlays on the screen. (8) Final shot of the creator posing with the purple drink cup in a brightly lit indoor seating area.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 4 primary female interviewees, 1 male staff member partially visible, 2 customers in background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with a slim build, hair tied in a bun, wearing a light-colored floral print sleeveless ruffle top and light blue denim jeans with a diagonal fly design.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between the storefront of a FamilyMart with its signature green/white/blue branding, an outdoor blue metal fence wall, and the brightly lit interior of the store showing product aisles, self-checkout kiosks, and seating areas.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong, danceable beat. The voice is bright and fast-paced. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' SFX accompanies a shift in the vocal rhythm as the main speaker introduces the product. (3) Sound of rhythmic laughter from multiple female voices as the interview section begins. A playful 'boing' cartoon SFX is heard. (4) A 'ding' SFX signals a transition back to the main narrator's review, with the BGM remaining consistent in tempo. (5) Another series of 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects punctuate the quick cuts of people eating, synced with the visual transitions. (6) The final phase features a more instructional, promotional tone from the main speaker with detailed price and date information, ending with a cheerful sign-off as the BGM fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Public Interview/Trial -> Product Features -> Multi-Product Synergy -> Limited Time Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a new collaboration between 'Jui Sui Kitchen' and FamilyMart's 'Fami!ce' ice cream brand, specifically focusing on the grass jelly (Xiancao) flavor and a taro milk drink. The video uses person-on-the-street reactions and social proof to build excitement for the product release and highlight specific discount dates.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct collaboration mentioned in logos and subtitles; clear display of product packaging and retail location; specific price promotion information provided.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video adopts a classic Taiwanese 'Variety Show' editing style, characterized by high-density colorful text overlays and playful SFX to keep engagement high in a short-form vertical format.
